brief:
Qatar is counting on the international community to pressure Israel into implementing a ceasefire agreement in Gaza, according to Shehab Wire. A spokesperson for the Qatari Foreign Ministry stressed that international pressure will be essential to securing compliance with the accord.

The Qatari diplomat underscored the critical role that global actors must play in ensuring the ceasefire terms are upheld. Doha has positioned itself as a key mediator in Gaza negotiations and continues to rely on broader international engagement to move the process forward.
